entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: A human general who led Urza's Argivian armies during the Brothers' War and later lingered in Urza's Tower as a spirit.

entities.name: Urza
aliases: Lord Protector of the Combined Kingdoms
entities.description: Leader of the Argivian armies whom Sharaman served and whose coronation as Lord Protector he attended.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Artificer whose contraptions let Sharaman's ghost take on solidity; she tried to talk him down.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who stopped Sharaman's spirit by stabbing him with her ghostblade.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whose dragon engines killed Sharaman's nephews.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra that ravaged Terisiare.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: The tower where Sharaman stayed in life and lingered as a spirit.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Equipment of Saheeli and Kaya that Sharaman broke.

entities.name: Sharaman's black crystal orb
entities.description: A creation of Urza in a silver cage that channeled psychic energy to Sharaman's spirit.

events.summary: Sharaman served Urza in the Brothers' War, surviving the battle against Mishra's War Machine with Urza.
events.quote: He was the only survivor along with Urza of the battle against Mishra's War Machine, where he broke his leg.

events.summary: Sharaman witnessed the Third Path's use of magic at the Fall of Terisia City.
events.quote: Sharaman was present at the Fall of Terisia City , where he was stunned at the Third Path 's use of magic

events.summary: Sharaman's nephews were lost to Mishra's dragon engines, leaving him disillusioned.
events.quote: particularly the loss of his nephews to Mishra 's dragon engines

events.summary: Saheeli and Kaya encountered Sharaman's ghost, who opposed their actions; he broke the Temporal Anchor and tried to flee, but Kaya stabbed him with her ghostblade, ending his spiritual existence.
events.quote: he broke the Temporal Anchor and tried to flee into full incorporeality, only barely stopped by Kaya, who stabbed him with her ghostblade, ending his spiritual existence.

relations.quote: leading Urza 's Argivian armies during the time of the Brothers' War

relations.note: Ended his spirit with her ghostblade
relations.quote: Kaya, who stabbed him with her ghostblade, ending his spiritual existence.
The black crystal orb, a creation of Urza
